node.title: M720 large h=3 gate replay
node.statement: The M720 gate arithmetic reproduces the two large h=3 banked calibration facts: full_census(128,3,17921)=18 anchored cores and full_census(256,3,65537)=129 anchored cores.
node.attack_surface: memory-controlled local exact replay of the two h=3 rows using compact sorted signature records
node.falsifier: a large h=3 replay returning a different anchored-core count, or a corrected banked calibration table
